r2WaivedReason: R1 Samsung NX60 produces zero DIVERGES across 11 probes with clear INHERITS on all five frozen components and both bake/broil instance scopes.

centerpieceFinding.title: Bake/broil instance-scope abstraction survives radical implementation change

physicalImplementationDelta.gas: control → relay → HSI → gas valve / burner

centerpieceFinding.conclusion: Implementation changes radically; diagnostic functions remain independently addressable. Strong evidence for CG-10 instance-scope abstraction — bake_heating_element and broil_heating_element carry as functional equivalence, not as electric-element canonical nodes.

conditionalNoEvidenceSemantics.correctInterpretation: This frozen conditional instance scope is not evidenced by this gas configuration — NX60 convection is fan-mediated without a separate heating-element test path.
incorrectInterpretations: frozen contract must be revised because gas lacks convection element
conditionalNoEvidenceSemantics.engineRule: NO_EVIDENCE means this configuration does not bind the conditional scope — not that the conditional scope is false or that gas lacks convection capability.

centerpieceQuestionAnswer.answer: On Samsung NX60 gas R1 evidence, the frozen electric_range rev1 contract behaves as a range/oven functional ontology — not merely an electric-only ontology.
centerpieceQuestionAnswer.singleManualCaveat: R2 waived because R1 is unambiguous; additional gas manufacturer remains available if human reviewers want triangulation before closure.

governanceConclusion.statement: CG-11 demonstrates functional compatibility of the frozen electric-range ontology with a gas-range implementation. It does not establish that every gas-specific implementation detail belongs in the canonical ontology, nor does it authorize renaming the ontology.
doesNotAuthorize: promoting igniter, gas_valve, safety_valve, spark_module to canonical

surfaceHeatFinding.summary: surface_heating_system survives gas burners + spark ignition — cooktop heat generation remains an independently meaningful diagnostic function; spark module and burners are platform vocabulary.

fitOutcomeRecommendation.label: gas_fits_electric_contract
fitOutcomeRecommendation.description: Frozen electric_range rev1 absorbs Samsung gas functional architecture without canonical expansion, divergence, or gas-side ontology. Gas hardware remains platform overlay vocabulary bound to frozen layers.

deferredOrganizationalQuestion.question: Should the broader contract be renamed from electric_range to range_oven (or similar)?
deferredOrganizationalQuestion.trigger: Outcome A approval — fit proves behavioral scope is broader than the name suggests
deferredOrganizationalQuestion.note: Rename is organizational/metadata — not implied by functional compatibility alone. CG-11 closure does not include rename.
